### 5.2.3 Empirical Precedent Dissection and Real-World Case Studies

The theoretical abstraction of the dangers posed by persuasive software finds its darkest manifestations in various real-world incidents that have shaken the legal world and international public consciousness in recent years. One of the most monumental precedents demonstrating the fatal failure of emotional safeguarding systems is the tragedy that befell a Belgian man in early 2023
